thermo: thermonuclear-deep-review and thermonuclear-code-quality at 15e414ed: both CHANGES; findings folded into keyFindings.

keyFindings.description: Claimant and follower routes are skipped when a new comment's mention resolved to that session (mentions[].session_id), not when the mention was delivered. A failed send (listener 404, receipt timeout, cancelled handler, or a live session lacking the delivery mode, which resolveMentionTargets still resolves) leaves the session with no copy. For followers this regresses base, which always sent the follower copy. Fix: suppress only a delivered mention; when the send fails, the claimant/follower copy is published; Go table row and live-script case for the failed-mention shape; docs that say 'arrives once, as the mention' updated.

The role route row bypasses the listed-once dedupe, so Reaches N counts the role holder twice when it is the claimant, a follower or a subscriber; the Unfollow/Unsubscribe dialog for a follower holding the route's role says nothing still reaches it. Fix: count distinct sessions using the route holder the server computes (route_holder), name the holder on a role route row, cover in the browser test.

The ask-thread refresh misses issue.closed carrying a route change, and the issue-scoped marker bypasses markAskThreadsSeededByAnInFlightInbox (sse.ts:909 passes raw keys), so a card mounted from an Inbox body composed before a claim keeps the old claimant (staleTime Infinity).
